8.37. iLock_Geography.switch_types¶

This module contains functionality for replacing nodes with new nodes of the same degree as the old node.

Currently there are two wrappers implemented:
  • CrossNodes2SSDX: Alter crossnodes to single slip diamond crossing nodes.
  • CrossNodes2DSDX: Alter crossnodes to double slip diamond crossing nodes.

Functions

alterSpecifiedNodes(railyard, nodeIndices, …) Function that alters specified nodes.
copyAttr(oldEntity, newEntity) Small help-function for copying over attributes from one entity to another.
crossNodes2DSDX(railyard, crossingType, locked) Returns a copy of the railyard where some crossnodes are altered to DSDX nodes.
crossNodes2SSDX(railyard, crossingType, locked) Returns a copy of the railyard where some crossnodes are altered to SSDX nodes.
getPointedNodeIndices(railyard, pointerType, …) Returns a list of a set of NodeIndices pointed out by the objects of type pointerType in a railyard.
locallyOrientedNode(node, edges) Check whether a node is locally oriented.
modifiedArea(area, oldNode, newNode, …) Returns a modified copy of the given IGraph (area).
modifiedPath(path, oldNode, newNode, …) Returns a modified copy of the given IPath (path).

Classes

DirObj2NodeTypePaths(railyard, degree) Class that generates paths from a directed object to a node of a specified degree.
